items.comments: The reservation was canceled 14 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Great communication before our trip. Nothing seemed too much trouble. In Seattle for a conference and hate hotels - this place was perfect - about 20 minute walk from downtown and conference centre, amazing views over the city from the top apartment. Clean, tidy and had everything you need for a stay!
The neighborhood was great for visiting Seattle.  Enjoyed our stay and had everything we needed.
